court_name: Superior Court of California, County of Mono
case_search_note: No online case search. Criminal records can be requested in person, by mail (P.O. Box 1037, Mammoth Lakes, CA 93546) or by email to criminal@mono.courts.ca.gov — see Name Searches and Records Requests: https://www.mono.courts.ca.gov/online-services/name-searches-and-records-requests

sources.title: Mono Superior Court — Mammoth Lakes Courthouse
CA Dept. of Insurance — Check Agent/Broker

courthouses.name: Mammoth Lakes Courthouse
courthouses.hours: Building Mon–Thu 8:30 a.m.–4 p.m., Fri 8:30 a.m.–12 p.m.; phones Mon–Fri 9 a.m.–12 p.m.
courthouses.note: Criminal calendar here on Mondays (arrive 8:30 a.m. to be added to the docket), per Criminal page. Mailing P.O. Box 1037. Criminal email criminal@mono.courts.ca.gov. Location page leaves 'cases served' blank. Hears Bridgeport matters when that courtroom is closed (it was closed Jan–Feb 2026).

courthouses.name: Bridgeport Courthouse
courthouses.hours: Tuesdays 9 a.m.–4 p.m.; clerk Tue 9:30 a.m.–3:30 p.m.
courthouses.note: Criminal calendar here on Tuesdays; location page lists criminal and traffic among cases served. Courtroom was closed Jan–Feb 2026 with proceedings moved to Mammoth Lakes — check current notices.

public_defenders.name: Mono County Public Defender
public_defenders.address: 549 Old Mammoth Road, Suite 10, Second Floor
public_defenders.note: Mailing PO Box 122. County page: Mono County currently contracts with local attorneys to provide indigent defense; ask the judge to appoint the Public Defender at your first appearance. Does not handle infractions, civil or family law.

probation.name: Mono County Probation Department
probation.hours: Mon–Thu 8 a.m.–5 p.m., Fri 8 a.m.–4 p.m.
probation.note: Second office: 1290 Tavern Rd, Mammoth Lakes, CA 93546 (same main number). Officers usually reachable Mon/Wed/Thu/Fri in Mammoth and Tue in Bridgeport. Correspondence: P.O. Box 596, Bridgeport. Fax (760) 932-5571. Mono has no juvenile hall (uses El Dorado County Juvenile Treatment Center).

programs.name: Pretrial Services (Mono County Probation)
programs.summary: On court referral, Probation screens and interviews arrestees at the jail and investigates community ties, record, failures to appear and danger, to report to the court on own-recognizance release.

programs.name: Mono County Drug Court
programs.summary: Collaborative court (Superior Court, Probation, DA, Behavioral Health, Public Defenders) connecting defendants with substantial substance addiction to community treatment, with alternative dispositions. Started with a 2015 grant.

jails.name: Mono County Jail
jails.phone_note: Number given by the court's Criminal page for in-custody info and by the Jail page for an inmate's future court dates.
jails.note: Visiting (non-contact only): Sun 1–5 p.m., Mon 1–5 p.m., Wed 1–5 p.m., Fri 7–9:30 p.m.; photo ID; no visit if jailed there in last 6 months. Money: cash or cashier's check in the jail lobby, or money orders by mail (P.O. Box 697, Bridgeport, CA 93517). court_ids: Bridgeport is nearest; criminal also heard Mondays in Mammoth Lakes — transport not confirmed.
jails.todo: Men/women housing not stated; a new jail is under construction (https://monocounty.ca.gov/2110/Mono-County-Jail-Under-Construction)

bail.note: CA Department of Insurance 'Check a License' (linked from insurance.ca.gov CheckAgntBrkr page) — look up any bail agent's license status. Mono Sheriff will not refer any bond agency and only deals with California-licensed agents. Cash bail must be the exact amount; cashier's checks and money orders accepted, no personal checks; cash over $10,000 requires valid ID plus original Social Security card.
